name: Zaffre
source:
As a former popstar, Zaffre rarely met humans outside of interviews and concerts. As a result, he's got both a disconnect from reality and an unmatched zest for life.

Likes: Singing, music, chivalry, attention, being pampered
Dislikes: Chores of any kind, work of any kind, movement in general

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chouette/belle-automata]Kickstarter[/url]]
